hypothesis: The two E5 first-policy input modes already differ in a shared pre-flattening source: the live canonical body state, PoseSearch target/reference state, or terrain root/ground state.

supporting_evidence_before_experiment.terrain_difference_pattern: Every packed terrain element differed by the same absolute amount, implicating a shared root or ground reference before packing.

competing_explanations: All pre-flattening sources are identical and tensor assembly, buffer ownership, or stale memory creates the packed-input difference.
PoseSearch time or reference state differs while the live body source remains identical.
The known Mode B depends on an uncontrolled startup scheduling state that will not recur in a bounded unchanged repetition set.
expected_if_hypothesis_correct: The trace is behavior-neutral for a repeated known mode, and when both known packed-input hashes occur at least one captured pre-flattening source field separates them.
falsification_observation: Both known packed-input hashes occur while all captured pre-flattening source fields remain identical.

deterministic_contracts.coverage: default state, explicit capture, first-capture latch/reset, finite values, quaternion normalization, and exact counts

baseline.configuration: Locked RealOnnxPolicy standing-plant v2 configuration; 1/60 s; 10 s; unchanged default seed, initial pose, no perturbation, action-semantic trace on, policy-input provenance trace off.

experimental.configuration: Identical binary, model, protocol, seed, pose, fixed step, capture window, evaluator, and action trace; only policy-input provenance trace was enabled.

mode_capture_attempt.repeat_rule_decision: Stopped after the third unchanged behavioral failure; no fourth launch was run.
mode_capture_attempt.reason: Only Mode A was observed, so no cross-mode provenance comparison exists.

conclusion.summary: The development-only provenance trace is valid and behavior-neutral for known Mode A: trace-off and two trace-on runs are byte-identical across all five locked raw streams and have the same locked failure set and readback ratio. The alternate Mode B did not recur within the three-run limit, so the experiment neither supports nor falsifies the claim that the modes differ in a captured pre-flattening source.
conclusion.what_was_learned: Mode A enters first inference on policy tick 1 at world time 0.033333335 s, with MM_Idle selected at 5.433333397 s, zero previous action and canonical velocities, and a fully valid source trace. Repeated uncontrolled launches are now low-information because they did not reproduce Mode B within the allowed bound.

next_highest_information_experiment.name: First-policy startup pose-propagation timing control
next_highest_information_experiment.hypothesis: The E5 mode split is caused by whether first policy inference observes the startup pose before or after one fixed skeletal and physics pose-propagation tick.
next_highest_information_experiment.single_variable: A development-only first-policy delay measured in fixed ticks, swept through runtime overrides with baseline 0 and candidate 1 while all other harness inputs remain locked.
next_highest_information_experiment.instrumentation: Reuse the validated provenance trace; add no production readback or serialization requirement.
next_highest_information_experiment.expected_if_correct: Exactly one delay value reproduces known Mode B hash 723FD94212B9047A079C11D7ABD572ADCA78DC1C62C87E3CD861D2F9ECEC2CC3 and exposes the earlier source field that changes.
next_highest_information_experiment.falsifier: Neither fixed-tick value reproduces Mode B, or both values retain Mode A without a source change.
next_highest_information_experiment.locked_metrics: Known exact first-input hashes, provenance source deltas, all five existing raw stream hashes, locked evaluator status/failure set, and target readback ratio; unchanged protocol and thresholds.
